quantitative_reasoning_questions.question_text: What was the percentage increase in average A&E waiting time at Northfield General between Q1 and Q3?
quantitative_reasoning_questions.answer_reason: Percentage increase = (112 − 84) ÷ 84 × 100 = 28 ÷ 84 × 100 ≈ 33.3%. Option A (25%) results from incorrectly dividing by the Q3 value. Option B (28%) treats the raw difference as a percentage directly.
